title: Budget, VJP and measurement vocabulary of the propagated beyond-VRAM case of G5-05: the judged run on the RTX 3060 finishes within the declared wall and disk-write budgets, produces a propagated spectrum and a real dense VJP, and records memory and disk figures separately

fixture.report: benchmarks/report_beyond_vram_propagated.py renders docs/BEYOND_VRAM_PROPAGATED.md and the sanitized evidence record from the driver record and optionally the whole-machine counter CSV of scripts/sample_system_counters.ps1
fixture.budget_basis: Judged run (rtx3060): the RTX 3060 wall-time model of the driver (refitted on the two streamed rehearsals of this case) predicts 5351 s for the forward, the VJP and two finite-difference forwards; four hours are declared, about 2.7 times the estimate, for a GPU shared with other agents. Optional run (rtx5880): the RTX 5880 model predicts 5501 s against the owner's three hours. Host banks write no state files; the only scratch writes are the .npy artifacts (about 0.1 GB on the RTX 3060, 0.3 GB on the RTX 5880) and the record.
fixture.scratch: none for the state (host banks); artifacts next to the record (D:/TorchFDTD/.local/runs/g5-05 on the RTX 3060 machine)

reference_method: Budgets are compared with the driver's own elapsed time and with psutil machine-wide disk counters over the phases; when the counter CSV is supplied, the integrated write bytes of the whole machine are judged as well. The VJP criteria are the gradient criteria of G5-05 (finite, nonzero, directional finite difference).

observables.name: elapsed_seconds
observables.definition: driver wall time from the first forward to the completed record, including the finite-difference forward

observables.name: machine_disk_write_bytes
observables.definition: psutil.disk_io_counters write bytes over each phase, summed over the forward, the backward and the finite-difference forward; whole machine

observables.name: integrated_write_bytes
observables.definition: rate times interval over the counter CSV when supplied

observables.name: peak_process_rss_bytes, peak_process_private_bytes
observables.definition: this process, sampled every half second

observables.name: peak_device_in_use_bytes
observables.definition: whole GPU, every process, from cudaMemGetInfo

observables.name: machine_disk_read_bytes
observables.definition: psutil machine-wide read bytes per phase

observables.name: system_counters
observables.definition: available, cache, standby and committed memory, disk read and write rates, CPU, from the whole-machine sampler when supplied

budget.justification: Two terabytes of writes and, for the RTX 5880, three hours were set by the program owner; the RTX 3060 wall budget of four hours is declared here at about 2.7 times the fitted estimate of 1.49 h because the GPU is shared. Host banks write nothing. The rehearsal limits are generous bounds for a shared RTX 3060. The disk figure is machine-wide and includes other processes.

vram.live_state_must_exceed_vram: state_bank_capacity x state_bytes plus dense_parameter_reservation_bytes of the streamed reservation must exceed the recorded physical VRAM
vram.eh_over_vram: reported and not judged: expected 0.21 on the RTX 3060 and 0.18 on the RTX 5880; see the statement in G5-05

vjp.definition: the dense epsilon gradient of the streamed backward must be finite with at least one nonzero entry, its design-slab norm positive, and its directional derivative must pass the finite-difference criteria of G5-05
vjp.no_convergence_claim: a passing first-derivative check on one direction does not declare an optimized or converged design; the record states this

measurement_vocabulary.rule: each figure is recorded for the forward and the backward separately and none are summed into a total memory figure; the whole-machine counters, when present, are reported beside them with their own scope text

not_yet_covered: the judged run itself (judged by benchmarks/report_beyond_vram_propagated.py --context rtx3060 after the run; test_judged_record_meets_g5_06 then reads docs/validation/beyond_vram_propagated_3060.json)
a physical-disk write measurement of the artifacts (the psutil counters are machine-wide and include other processes)

notes: Applicability: the rehearsal record exercises every criterion of this case in the rehearsal context on the local RTX 3060; the judged criteria (four-hour wall, two-terabyte writes, live state above the RTX 3060 physical VRAM) can only be judged on the RTX 3060 record of the 64 um instance, so G5-06 stays NOT_RUN until then; the RTX 5880 entries describe the optional larger run. The case was added in the commit following 73203d2 together with G5-05, its budget basis updated with G5-05's central-difference revision, and re-scoped to the RTX 3060 judged run on the owner's decision before any judged run.
